design_identity: Native twelve-point construction compared across 1897,1900 and1904 specimens. Existing32textfamilies reviewed; no identical revived cut.

choices.reason: Larger and finer native source than1897 counterparts; all stroke joins observed.
Complete matching twelve-point characters missing from the census row. Threshold180 after local paper normalisation keeps hairlines and reduces the soft scan fringe;200 was visibly too heavy.
Clearer matching twelve-point native impressions, complete R leg and an explicitly printed period. Threshold175 retains their light cut.
Sharper high-contrast scan confirms construction, but printing spread varies among sorts; retained photographic sources better preserve the light strokes in this master.

rejected_trials.reason: R leg disconnects; not a complete trace. Q hairline tail also weakens.
Soft scan fringe thickens curves and diagonal strokes against the finer census witnesses.

corrections: Rigid rotations from paired capline/baseline measurements: census+0.235589deg,1897+0.086836deg,document-0.307390deg in y-up font coordinates. No shear, width stretching, hole filling or invented repairs.
review: All37 visible glyphs inspected against native crops, word proofs16/24/40/64/96px and isolated32/180px outlines. All intended counters remain closed.

card_addition.reason: Complete light ampersand with two open counters and intact rising right terminal at175; higher thresholds unnecessarily thicken the source fringe.
card_addition.period_comparison: The two card periods do not improve the clearer document-period source, which remains exact.
card_addition.visual_review: Native size and construction proofs, six threshold alternatives, and words at16/24/40/64/96pixels inspected.
